sentences.text: Biswadip Paul @ Biswajit vs Unknown on 18 January, 2023

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
18.01.2023 Serial no. 17 [Dd] (Anticipatory bail) (Rejected) Crm (A) 222 of 2023 In re : An
Application for Anticipatory Bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection
with Habibpur Police Station Case No. 315 of 2022 dated 29.09.2022 under Sections
498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

-And- 
In the matter of : Biswadip Paul @ Biswajit ... ...Petitioner Mr. Amitava Karmakar, Mr. Arup Kr.
Bhowmick, Advocates ... ... For the Petitioner Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji, ld. Pp Mr. Aniket Mitra,
Advocates ... ...For the State
There are allegations in the case diary implicating the petitioner, the husband of the victim, meting out torture on the victim.
The death occurred within 9 months of marriage.
In such circumstances, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
